transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. I came in because, well, I just feel worn out almost every single day. It's like... even after I get a full night's sleep, my body and my head are still just dragging when I have to get up for my cashier shifts. I just wanted to see if we could figure out what's going on.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly or stop breathing for moments while you're asleep?
No, um, not that I know of. Nobody's ever mentioned anything like that to me. I don't think I snore, and I definitely haven't been told that I stop breathing or anything.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel sad or anything like that. I still like doing my normal stuff when I'm not working. It's just... I'm just really tired all the time. But no, I haven't been feeling down or losing interest in things.
Have you noticed any unexplained weight gain or weight loss recently?
No, my weight's been pretty much the same. I haven't noticed any big changes, up or down, lately.
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep at night?

Yeah, I do. Um, most nights I get in bed really tired, but then I just lie there. My mind starts going over the bills, my work schedule, or just worrying about whether everyone at home is okay. And then... even when I finally do get to sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down.
Have you noticed feeling unusually cold, having dry skin, or experiencing hair thinning lately?
No, I haven't noticed any of that. Um, I don't feel colder than usual, and my skin seems fine. My hair is just... normal, I guess. So no, nothing like that.
Aside from bedtime, do you find yourself worrying excessively about things like bills, work, or family during the day, and do you have trouble controlling or stopping those worries?

Yeah, all day, honestly. It feels like my mind is always jumping from one thing to the next. Like, I'll be at the register and suddenly I'm worrying about money, or the relative we have staying with us right now. Then I start thinking about how stressed my wife is, or what I need to do for church, and then I'm right back to worrying if I'm messing up at work. It's just constant. I try to push it away, but I can't really stop it.
Do you often feel physically restless, on edge, or notice muscle tension along with this worrying?

No, not really. I mean, my mind is definitely racing all the time, but my body feels okay. I don't really get sore muscles or feel jittery and restless... it's mostly just all in my head. So, no, I haven't noticed any physical tension like that.
Have you noticed feeling lightheaded, short of breath with activity, or looking unusually pale lately?
No, I don't think so. I haven't felt dizzy or lightheaded, and I can breathe just fine when I'm moving around. I don't think I look pale either. So, no, none of that.
How long have you been experiencing this constant, hard-to-control worrying throughout the day?
It's been going on for a while now. I'd say about a year and three months. It really started up around the time our older relative moved in with us, and it just hasn't stopped since then.
